name: 百度地图
text:
#!name=百度地图
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/dss0\.bdstatic\.com\/-0U0bnSm1A5BphGlnYG\//i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/dss0\.bdstatic\.com\/.+\/tam-ogel\/.+\.(jpg|mp4)/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/tb1\.bdstatic\.com\/tb\/cms\/ngmis\/adsense\/*.jpg/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/tb2\.bdstatic\.com\/tb\/mobile\/spb\/widget\/jump/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ss0\.bdstatic\.com\/.+?_\d{3}_\d{4}\.jpg/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/gss0\.bdstatic\.com\/.+?\/static\/wiseindex\/img\/bd_red_packet\.png/i then reject_img(200)

[Rule]
DOMAIN, afd.baidu.com,REJECT
DOMAIN, afdconf.baidu.com,REJECT
DOMAIN, httpdns.baidubce.com,REJECT
DOMAIN, lc.map.baidu.com,REJECT

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% dss0.bdstatic.com, tb1.bdstatic.com, tb2.bdstatic.com, ss0.bdstatic.com, gss0.bdstatic.com, newclient.map.baidu.com
